create_graph_node: create an FX graph node with opcode call_function, call_method, get_attr, call_module, placeholder, or output
build_graph_python_code: build valid Python source code from an FX Graph object using the python_code method
refactor_graph_eliminate_dead_code: refactor an FX graph by removing unused nodes that have no users
test_graph_lint: test an FX graph for correct ownership, topological order, and valid module targets
build_graph_copy: build a copy of an FX graph into another graph with node value remapping
